name: PD 78 was established by Ordinance No. 14877, passed by the Dallas City Council on April 28, 1975. Ordinance No. 14877 amended Ordinance No. 10962, Chapter 51 of the 1960 Revised Code of Civil and Criminal Ordinances of the City of Dallas. Subsequently, Ordinance No. 15362, passed by the Dallas City Council on December 13, 1976, repealed Ordinance No. 14877 and reestablished PD 78. Ordinance No. 15362 was amended by Resolution No. 78-0213, passed by the Dallas City Council on January 18, 1978. (Ord. Nos. 10962; 14877; 15362; 25423; Res. 78-0213)
source: Dallas City Code ch. 51P, Article 78 (City Attorney's codified article, April 2026)

sections.title: Article heading
sections.text: ARTICLE 78. PD 78.

sections.title: Legislative History
sections.text: SEC. 51P-78.101.LEGISLATIVE HISTORY. PD 78 was established by Ordinance No. 14877, passed by the Dallas City Council on April 28, 1975. Ordinance No. 14877 amended Ordinance No. 10962, Chapter 51 of the 1960 Revised Code of Civil and Criminal Ordinances of the City of Dallas. Subsequently, Ordinance No. 15362, passed by the Dallas City Council on December 13, 1976, repealed Ordinance No. 14877 and reestablished PD 78. Ordinance No. 15362 was amended by Resolution No. 78-0213, passed by the Dallas City Council on January 18, 1978. (Ord. Nos. 10962; 14877; 15362; 25423; Res. 78-0213)

sections.title: Property Location And Size
sections.text: SEC. 51P-78.102.PROPERTY LOCATION AND SIZE. PD 78 is established on property generally located along the north right-of-way line of the Interstate Highway 635 service road, east and west of Hughes Lane. The size of PD 78 is approximately 36.429 acres. (Ord. Nos. 15362; 25423; 28943)

sections.title: Definitions And Interpretations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-78.103.DEFINITIONS AND INTERPRETATIONS. article.
(a)Unless otherwise stated, the definitions and interpretations in Chapter 51 apply to this
(b)Unless otherwise stated, all references to articles, divisions, or sections in this article are to articles, divisions, or sections in Chapter 51. (Ord. 25423)

sections.title: Development Plan
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-78.104.DEVELOPMENT PLAN.
(a)Except as provided in Subsections (b) and (c), all development within the boundaries of this PD must be in accordance with the development plan (Exhibit 78A).
(b)Within Phases 1, 2, and 3, two or more lots may be combined into one lot for one dwelling unit without replatting, or lots may be replatted into a different arrangement as long as the street configuration remains the same, the total number of lots does not exceed 125 lots for the entire PD or more than 37 lots within the Phase 3 area, and all lots are in compliance with the standards as set forth in this article.
(c)In the event the lots are replatted in accordance with Subsection (b) of this section, a revised development plan for the entire PD must be submitted for approval by the city plan commission and must be attached to Ordinance No. 15362 by resolution of the city council. (Ord. Nos. 15362; 25423; Res. 78-0213)

sections.title: Development Schedule
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-78.105.DEVELOPMENT SCHEDULE.
(a)Development must occur in three phases as shown on the development plan although initial development may occur in either Phase 1 or Phase 3, or in Phase 1 and Phase 3 simultaneously.
(b)In conjunction with the development of Phase 1 and/or Phase 3, Hughes Lane must be extended as a secondary thoroughfare through this PD and must be in place, including any necessary bridge structures or culverts, prior to the issuance of a certificate of occupancy for any building or use within Phase 1 or Phase 3.
(c)Phase 2 may be developed simultaneously with Phase 1 or Phase 3. No certificates of occupancy, however, may be issued for any building or use in Subsection (b) of this section within Phase 2 until Hughes Lane is in place as specified.
(d)If no development has occurred within this PD within 12 months after passage of Ordinance No. 15362, the city council of its own initiative may authorize a hearing to determine the proper zoning on the property. (Ord. Nos. 15362; 25423)

sections.title: Uses
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-78.106.USES. Permitted uses within this PD are as follows:
(1)Phase 1 - Single-family detached dwellings.
(2)Phase 2 - Single-family detached dwellings.
(3)Phase 3 - Townhouse dwellings, private community center or clubhouse with related uses such as outdoor, tennis courts, and swimming pools. The site designated on the development plan for the private community center or clubhouse may not be used for residential purposes. (Ord. Nos. 15362; 25423)

sections.title: Landscape Plan
sections.text: SEC. 51P-78.107.LANDSCAPE PLAN. Landscaping must be provided as development occurs within Phase 3 in accordance with the approved landscape plan (Exhibit 78B). (Ord. Nos. 15362; 25423)

sections.title: Subdivision Plat
sections.text: SEC. 51P-78.108.SUBDIVISION PLAT. Prior to the issuance of a building permit within the PD, a subdivision plat, as approved by the city plan commission, must be filed for record with the county clerk’s office. (Ord. Nos. 15362; 25423)

sections.title: Density
sections.text: SEC. 51P-78.109.DENSITY. A maximum of 125 dwelling units is permitted within this PD, including the existing house at the northeast corner of the site. (Ord. Nos. 15362; 25423)

sections.title: Building Standards
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-78.110.BUILDING STANDARDS.
(a)Phase 1 - Single-family detached dwellings. All dwelling units in Phase 1 must be detached and be constructed in accordance with the following standards:
(1)Minimum lot size - 8,600 square feet.
(2)Minimum lot width - 60 feet at the front building line.
(3)Minimum front yard setback - 25 feet.
(4)Minimum side yard setback - 10 percent of the width of the lot at the front yard setback line to a maximum of 10 feet.
(5)Minimum rear yard setback - 10 feet, with detached garages and accessory buildings allowed in compliance with the provisions of Section 22, “Accessory Buildings,” of the Comprehensive Zoning Ordinance.
(6)Maximum lot coverage - 45 percent.
(7)Maximum building height - 24 feet, as measured in accordance with the definition of height in Section 33-132 of the Comprehensive Zoning Ordinance.
(b)Phase 2 - Single-family detached dwellings. All dwelling units in Phase 2 must be detached and must be constructed in accordance with the standards of the Residential - 16,000 Square Foot District of the Comprehensive Zoning Ordinance, except that each lot may be developed under the provisions of Section 10-800, “Community Unit Development,” of the Comprehensive Zoning Ordinance.
(c)Phase 3 - Townhouse dwellings. All townhouse units in Phase 3 must be constructed in accordance with Townhouse-1 District standards as specified in the Comprehensive Zoning Ordinance for lot area, front yard, side yard, and rear yard requirements. All lots, however, not adjoining the creek or floodway easement area are restricted to a maximum height of 24 feet and measured in accordance with the definition of height in Section 33-132 of the Comprehensive Zoning Ordinance. Minimum lot width and lot depth must be established as shown on the development plan. Each lot is limited to a maximum coverage of 80 percent.
(d)Phase 3 - Community center. The private community center or clubhouse must be developed in accordance with a site plan to be approved by the city plan commission and attached to and made a part of Ordinance No. 15362 by resolution of the city council prior to the issuance of a building permit. Maximum building height is 24 feet. (Ord. Nos. 15362; 25423)

sections.title: Screening
sections.text: SEC. 51P-78.111.SCREENING. Screening must be provided as shown on the development plan and must be in place as development occurs within the designated phases. (Ord. Nos. 15362; 25423)

sections.title: Dedication
sections.text: SEC. 51P-78.112.DEDICATION. All necessary street right-of-way must be dedicated to the city upon the platting of the property as required in Section 51P-78.108 of this article. (Ord. Nos. 15362; 25423)

sections.title: Circulation
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-78.113.CIRCULATION.
(a)Stonebrook Circle must be extended through this PD as a minor street from existing right-of-way on the eastern boundary of the property in a westerly direction to Hughes Lane.
(b)Hughes Lane must be extended through this PD as a secondary thoroughfare and must be in place in accordance with the provisions of the development schedule in Subsection 51P-78.105 of this article. (Ord. Nos. 15362; 25423)

sections.title: Floodway Easement Line
sections.text: SEC. 51P-78.114.FLOODWAY EASEMENT LINE. The development plan and all plats involving property within this PD must indicate a 100-year floodway easement line along the creek, with lots platted only to that line and with access to the easement from public property. Property within this floodway maintenance easement must be maintained in its natural state as much as reasonably possible. (Ord. Nos. 15362; 25423)

sections.title: Off-Street Parking
sections.text: SEC. 51P-78.115.OFF-STREET PARKING. Off-street parking must be provided at the ratio of two spaces per unit for all residential dwelling units. (Ord. Nos. 15362; 25423)

sections.title: Signs
sections.text: SEC. 51P-78.116.SIGNS. All signs must comply with the non-business rules as specified in Article IV of Chapter 41, “Sign Standards,” of the Dallas City Code. (Ord. Nos. 15362; 25423)

sections.title: Lighting
sections.text: SEC. 51P-78.117.LIGHTING. Lighting within the PD must give an indirect and soft lighting effect and may not shine directly onto any adjacent property. Light standards on tennis courts must reflect the light downwards and not reflect light onto any adjoining property. All tennis court lights must be turned off by 10:00 p.m. (Ord. Nos. 15362; 25423)

sections.title: Homeowners’ Association
sections.text: SEC. 51P-78.118.HOMEOWNERS’ ASSOCIATION. In connection with this PD, proper evidence showing the execution and filing of covenants creating a homeowners’ association for Phase 3 must be submitted to the city plan commission. The structure of the association must be approved by the city attorney prior to the sale of any lot or tract within Phase 3 of this PD and must be filed for record with the county clerk. If a homeowners’ association for Phase 1 and 2 is required, it must conform generally to Phase 3 documents. (Ord. Nos. 15362; 25423)

sections.title: Maintenance
sections.text: SEC. 51P-78.119.MAINTENANCE. The entire premises of Phase 3 after development must be maintained in a state of good repair and neat appearance. All easements, common areas, landscaped areas, screening, recreation areas, and facilities must be maintained in perpetuity by the homeowners’ association. (Ord. Nos. 15362; 25423)

sections.title: General Requirements
sections.text: SEC. 51P-78.120.GENERAL REQUIREMENTS. All development within this PD must be in conformance with all codes and regulations of the city. The Comprehensive Zoning Ordinance governs development unless a different standard is specified in this article. (Ord. Nos. 15362; 25423)

sections.title: Paving
sections.text: SEC. 51P-78.121.PAVING. All paved areas, permanent drives, streets, and drainage structures, if any, must be constructed in accordance with standard city specifications to the satisfaction of the director of public works and transportation. (Ord. Nos. 15362; 25423; 26102)

sections.title: Compliance With Conditions
sections.text: SEC. 51P-78.122.COMPLIANCE WITH CONDITIONS. No certificate of occupancy may be issued by the building official until there has been full compliance with this article and any applicable provisions of the zoning ordinance and the building codes. (Ord. Nos. 15362; 25423)

sections.title: Zoning Map
sections.text: SEC. 51P-78.123.ZONING MAP. PD 78 is located on Zoning Map No. D-7. (Ord. 25423)
